findings.issue_text: getForLogin() re-enters the caching provider via session.identityProviders().getById(id) for every cached ID instead of resolving through idpDelegate.getById(id)
OrganizationCacheTest cleanup uses the literal alias "alias" instead of the created aliases ("idp-alias-" + i and "idp-alias-20"), leaving identity providers behind and contaminating later tests

goldens.comment: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.getForLogin() recursively calls session.identityProviders().getById() instead of idpDelegate.getById(), causing the cache lookup to re-enter the same caching layer.
Cleanup reference uses incorrect alias - should be 'idp-alias-' + i instead of 'alias'.
